requirements.evidence: Routes/views/config exist, but password.reset hash check uses Hash::check on a sha1 URL hash (app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerificationController.php:26), the reset flow flashes trans($status) for every broker result (app/Http/Controllers/Auth/PasswordResetController.php:37), lang keys are wrong (lang/pt_BR.json:865-866), theme paths resolve to .../mail/html/html/themes (config/mail.php:121), and password routes lack the required guest middleware (routes/web.php:16-19).

conventions.evidence: No tests were added at all (no test files in change.diff), violating TDD; reset controller is under app/Http/Controllers/Auth (contract says app/Http/Controllers); views use Tailwind classes (resources/views/auth/forgot-password.blade.php:5) instead of Bulma; dead imports in PasswordResetController.php:12-25.

security.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Auth/PasswordResetController.php:41-43 returns trans($status) unchanged, so a non-existent address yields 'passwords.user' ("We can't find a user..."), enabling user enumeration; VerificationController.php:97-110 never compares route('id') with the logged-in user's key.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ files and no assertions for any new route, view, notification or mail theme; every new behavior is untested.

simplicity.evidence: PasswordResetController.php:12-17 imports non-existent classes (PasswordResetBroker, PasswordBrokerFactory, PasswordBrokerInterface, PasswordBrokerResolver) and 20-25 import six unused facades plus a duplicate Validator alias; password rule duplicates min:8 with new PasswordRule() (line 53) and VerificationController.php:13 re-checks a signature already enforced by the signed middleware.

readability.evidence: Large block of unused/made-up imports (PasswordResetController.php:12-19) and a dead commented dispatch line at PasswordResetController.php:60 ("// Event::dispatch(new PasswordReset($user))...") obscure the real flow; method names request()/email()/reset() are vague.

scope.evidence: All touched files (controllers, routes, views, theme CSS, lang, phpunit.xml, config/mail.php) serve the task; only the extra markdown 'paths' override (config/mail.php:120-121) and Tailwind styling go slightly beyond what was asked, with no unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: The verification hash is sha1($email), but the code calls Hash::check($email, $request->route('hash')), which expects a bcrypt hash and therefore always fails, so every valid verification link returns 403; it must compare with hash_equals(..., sha1($email)).
The controller never compares the {id} route parameter with the authenticated user's key, so the required "id and hash match" check is missing (only hasVerifiedEmail and the hash are checked).

The controller flashes trans($status) for whatever Password::sendResetLink returns, so an unknown address produces the 'passwords.user' message instead of 'passwords.sent', revealing whether the e-mail exists.

The added keys 'resetPassword' and 'verifyYourEmailAddress' are not the source strings the Laravel notifications translate; the contract requires JSON entries for "Reset your password" and "Verify your email address", so both subjects remain in English.

Setting mail.markdown.paths to resources/views/vendor/mail/html makes the theme resolve as .../mail/html/html/themes/pegafila.css, so the custom theme is never found and the #0f7490 brand color is not applied; the default resource_path('views/vendor/mail') is correct.
The password-reset routes are not restricted to guests despite the task specifying the flow is guests only; they need the 'guest' middleware.
The contract places the password-reset controller under app/Http/Controllers, but it was created in app/Http/Controllers/Auth (only verification belongs in Auth).

No Pest/PHPUnit tests accompany the change, leaving the reset endpoints, the notification rendering/locale, the verification route and the mail theme completely unverified, contrary to the project's test-first rule.
The new views use Tailwind utility classes (container mx-auto, bg-green-100, bg-blue-600), while the project's UI convention is Bulma; reset-password.blade.php has the same issue.

Imports of non-existent classes (PasswordResetBroker, PasswordBrokerFactory, PasswordBrokerInterface, PasswordBrokerResolver) and six unused facades plus a duplicate Validator alias add noise and imply APIs that do not exist.
The password rule combines 'min:8' with new PasswordRule(), which already enforces the minimum length, letters, mixed case and numbers, so part of the rule is redundant.

The custom theme defines only button rules and replaces Laravel's default theme entirely, so the rest of the markdown mail (wrapper, tables, headings) loses its base styling; it should extend the default theme rather than replace it.
Requirement 1 states .env.example must ship APP_NAME=PegaFila, APP_LOCALE=pt_BR and APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE=en, but the diff only pins them in phpunit.xml; the .env.example update is absent.

review.summary: The change adds pt-BR password-reset and email-verification flows (controllers, routes, Blade views, mail theme, lang keys and phpunit pins), but the verification hash check uses Hash::check against a sha1 hash so valid links always 403, and the required id comparison is missing. The reset flow leaks whether an address exists, the notification subjects are not translated because the lang keys are wrong, the mail theme path is misconfigured, the routes are not guest-only, and no tests ship. This needs substantial rework before merging.
